children: Franklin Templeton’s digital assets account, FTDA, posted job openings on X for several roles related to digital assets and crypto and said it is accepting direct messages. According to ChainCatcher, the positions include head of digital asset product strategy, head of capital formation for Franklin Crypto, head of private credit for Franklin Crypto, digital audience engagement project manager, and vice president of crypto markets business development.

title: Franklin Templeton Digital Assets Opens Multiple Crypto-Related Roles
